purpose: Implement explicit Change -> observed Consequence -> Decision memory with conditions, confounders and confidence so N0TE can remember what happened after a real Song change without silently claiming causality or promoting one result into a universal rule.

lineage.outcome: The artist can revisit a real Song change, see what was observed afterward under which conditions/confounders, and see the explicit decision that followed without N0TE turning temporal association into causal doctrine.

legacy_candidates: experiment/change consequence semantics as behavioral evidence only

completion_proof: an owned Song/Session can create an immutable Learning episode with explicit domain, subject and represented change
multiple Consequence observations preserve source provenance, confidence, conditions and confounders in append order
creating an episode or positive consequence does not create Skill assessments, EvidenceMemory doctrine, causal rules, success rules or friction rules
a Decision requires at least one observation and is one-time KEEP/REVERT/REVISE/INCONCLUSIVE with rationale and confidence
no Consequence may be appended after the Decision and no history row may be updated or deleted
foreign-profile episode IDs are invisible and corrupt cross-Song Session bindings fail visibly on reopen
restart preserves episode/change/consequence/decision content and order
Learning lifecycle events journal into canonical Activity
repeated episode/history reads perform zero canonical writes
the data model contains no field asserting that a represented change caused any observed consequence
next_selection_rule: After CORE-02C evidence, reconcile and globally compare explicit repeated-friction/success memory against preserved CORE-03 capability/tool/template work. Do not grow causal inference or recommendation heuristics by adjacency.
